items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...I know several of the brothers. ... What did he play? John Hand. [INTERVIEWER] That's what I thought. John Hand Sr. was named after him.

ctx.x: September the 8th. Can you tell me anything about your family? Did your father play music? I know several of the brothers.
Well, the whole family was musical. The whole family. Mother, father, sister, brothers. All the whole family was musical. What was your father's name? What did he play? John Hand.
That's what I thought. John Hand Sr. was named after him. That's right.
